basic_details.job_title: DIAT Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Senior Project Associate, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for DIAT Recruitment 2026 will be conducted on 4 November 2026 at 1100 Hrs at Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Girinagar, Pune - 411 025. The selection is being held for 02 temporary project posts, comprising 01 Senior Project Associate on a monthly stipend of Rs. 42,000/- plus 30% HRA and 01 Junior Research Fellow on a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus 30% HRA.

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Senior Project Associate (SPA) Not to exceed 40 Years Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Not to exceed 28 Years | The crucial date for determining the upper age limit is 4 November 2026.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in CSE/IT/ECE/related domain from a recognized University or equivalent, and four years' experience in Research and Development, Industrial, Academic Institution or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.
B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in CSE/IT/ECE/related domain from recognized University/Institution in First Division with NET/GATE OR M.E./M.Tech in First Division both at Graduate and Post graduate level.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates and testimonials for detailed scrutiny. One set of attested copies of all original certificates and testimonials. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer for candidates currently working in Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Bodies.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Girinagar, Pune at 1100 Hrs on 4 November 2026. A detailed scrutiny of original certificates and testimonials alongside attested photocopies will be conducted before candidates are evaluated through the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The offer does not confer any right for absorption in DIAT, Pune. The engagement may be terminated at any time on one month's notice. In addition to the monthly stipend, medical facilities limited to MI Room facilities shall be extended. No TA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. For further details or clarification, candidates may contact Dr. Upasna Singh, PI, Department of CSE on telephone (020) 2460 4533 or mobile +91 9420213114.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview date for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 4 November 2026 at 1100 Hrs.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview venue for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Girinagar, Pune - 411 025.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced under DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 02 vacancies are available, comprising 01 Senior Project Associate (SPA) and 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in CSE/IT/ECE/related domain in First Division with NET/GATE, or an M.E./M.Tech in First Division both at Graduate and Post graduate level.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Project Associate and Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not to exceed 40 years for Senior Project Associate and not to exceed 28 years for Junior Research Fellow as on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible for age relaxation under DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Upper age limit relaxation is up to 05 years for SC/ST, Women, and PwBD candidates, and 03 years for OBC (NCL) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend for the posts?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 42,000/- plus 30% HRA for Senior Project Associate and Rs. 37,000/- plus 30% HRA for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q8. Are these positions permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The positions are purely temporary for 04 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier, and do not confer any right for absorption in DIAT Pune.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their original certificates and testimonials, a set of attested photocopies, and a No Objection Certificate from their employer if currently serving in government or PSU organizations.
